name: Visitor
summary: Represents an operation to be performed on the elements of an object structure, and lets a new operation be defined without changing the classes of those elements.

roles.name: Visitor
roles.summary: Declares one visit operation per concrete element of the structure.

roles.name: ConcreteVisitor
roles.summary: Implements the visit operations: this is where the added algorithm lives.

roles.name: Element
roles.summary: Declares the entry point of the double dispatch.

roles.name: ConcreteElement
roles.summary: Dispatches to the visit operation that corresponds to its own type.

roles.name: ObjectStructure
roles.summary: Holds the elements, and offers a way to walk them.

roles.name: VisitMethod
roles.summary: The operation applied to one given concrete element.

roles.name: AcceptMethod
roles.summary: The entry point of the double dispatch: it calls back the matching visit operation.
